title: Huny Bucket
description:
The Non-Stick Silicone Huny Bucket is perfect for anything sticky giving you the ability to remove 100% of your material. You can also easily label your jars with preprinted labels.
The outer case of the container is made out of a rigid plastic with a SCREW TOP LID. Which is not common for concentrate containers. There is no chance of the lid coming off in your pocket with the Huny Bucket.
